sections.heading: Wobbleoperator
sections.content:
The Wobble operator allows you to simulate rotational springs on particles.

The Wobble operator works by coupling each particle with a new child particle in a 2-way relationship that has the following constraints: child particles will attempt to maintain their translational offset from their parent using a simple spring, and parent particles will adjust their orientation to continually look at their child along a specified axis.

sections.heading: Spring solver
sections.content:
X/Y/Z: the child offset axis.Scale: the distance each child will be offset from its parent.Stiffness: the stiffness of the spring.Decay: the decay of the spring.Variation %: the per-particle percentage of variation to apply.Max force: the maximum length of the spring force vector.

X/Y/Z: the child offset axis.

Scale: the distance each child will be offset from its parent.

Stiffness: the stiffness of the spring.

Decay: the decay of the spring.

Max force: the maximum length of the spring force vector.

sections.heading: Axis affect
sections.content: Lock X/Y/Z: controls whether the wobble effect for each axis (relative to the particle’s local transform) will be locked (disabled).

sections.heading: Driver Particles
sections.content:
Delete if parent deleted: if a parent particle is deleted, the child particle will automatically be deleted.Get shape from parent: controls whether child particles will inherit the shape mesh of their parent.Inherit target link from parent: when disabled, target links between the parent particle and the parent particle’s target will not be inherited by child particles.

Delete if parent deleted: if a parent particle is deleted, the child particle will automatically be deleted.

Get shape from parent: controls whether child particles will inherit the shape mesh of their parent.

Inherit target link from parent: when disabled, target links between the parent particle and the parent particle’s target will not be inherited by child particles.

sections.heading: Display
sections.content: Show spring connections: controls whether a line will be drawn in the viewport connecting child parents with their parent.

sections.heading: Uniqueness
sections.content: Seed: the seed value for all varied parameters.
